main.description: A poll attached to a post. Use the post's record key as this record's key. Polls cannot be changed once indexed: delete and post again. Votes are public records.

post.description: The post the poll belongs to, in the same repo.

endsAt.description: At most 30 days after the poll is published.

mode.description: 'account': one vote per account; 'verified': one vote per account that verified a phone number or passed KYC; 'token': each vote weighs the voter's balance of the asset at the snapshot block (the latest block when the indexer first saw the poll), summed over the voter's linked wallets.

asset.description: For 'token' polls: the token (on a chain Krao indexes).

resultsVisibility.description: 'always' (default) or 'afterEnd': counts are hidden until the poll ends.
